scope: Installed B41 local consumers; mod registration is outside this static corpus

readings.alarm: Both AlarmClockClothing constructors initialize isDigital=true then set false when fullType.contains("Classic"). isDigital returns that field. The inventory menu requires isDigital before offering set/stop alarm. This is a native predicate, not a prose name heuristic.
readings.radio: ZomboidRadio.UpdateScripts collects player speech and accepts powered two-way devices with an unmuted microphone and the player within microphone range, including equipped portable radios via checkPlayerForDevice. addFrequencyListEntry leads to SendTransmission. ReceiveTransmission and DistributeTransmission/DistributeToPlayer match receiving channel and range before AddDeviceText. Claim speech transmission on a matching frequency within range; do not promise VOIP, unlimited reach, or successful delivery under every runtime state.
readings.trap: ISTrapMenu admits uncooked Food without extras/Drink and with sufficient hunger (or Worm). ISAddBaitAction sends self.bait:getFullType(); STrapSystem forwards args.bait; STrapGlobalObject.addBait stores it unchanged. checkForAnimal requires v.baits[self.bait] on registered Animals. A full local Lua search found registration and baits assignments only in TrapDefinition, plus a test consumer. Recipe conversions produce other item identities; their accepted bait uses must not be inherited by raw input. Direct animal acceptance is required for public hunting-purpose wording.
readings.drum: ISBlacksmithMenu checks positive type-specific campingLightFireType first, then truthiness of campingLightFireCategory[item:getCategory()]. Unlike other fire menus it does not apply a fabric-only predicate. Clothing category includes jewellery. The drum must have logs and not be lit or have charcoal; literature lighting consumes the selected item. Retain grounded drum tinder purpose regardless of real-world material.
